en: The front of the postcard depicts a vibrant port scene with several large ships, including one with a prominent red star on its bow, indicating a possible connection to the socialist era. People are seen standing near the water's edge, observing the ships and the busy harbor full of cranes and vessels. The sky is clear with a few scattered clouds. The reverse of the postcard includes text in several languages (Bulgarian, English, French, German) identifying the port as Varna and mentions a photographer's name, V. Schröter. There are additional publication and library stamps.
